mapper.select: select message_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, msg_type, content, is_read, send_datetime from t_chat_message where (from_user_id = #{me} and to_user_id = #{peer}) or (from_user_id = #{peer} and to_user_id = #{me}) order by send_datetime asc limit 200
select from_user_id as fromUserId, count(*) as cnt from t_chat_message where to_user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0 group by from_user_id
